user.title: Step 1 -- Connect to the ISM7
user.description:
Connection details for your ISM7 gateway.

Note: The ISM7 only allows one active connection at a time. If you were previously using the ism7mqtt add-on, stop it before setup -- otherwise the connection will fail.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ISM7 (e.g. 192.168.1.50).
data_description.password: Password as configured in the ISM7.

devices.title: Looking for modules...
devices.description: Briefly connecting to the ISM7 to detect attached modules.

resolve_ambiguous.title: Step 2 -- Clarify device types
resolve_ambiguous.description:
The following modules could not be uniquely identified. Pick the matching device type for each.

Hint: CWL ventilation units often report themselves as "SM1" -- if you have a CWL, pick it explicitly here.

select_discovered.title: Step 3 -- Select modules
select_discovered.description: These modules were detected on the ISM7. All are pre-selected -- you can deselect any you do not want in Home Assistant.

add_more.title: Step 4 -- Add sub-modules
add_more.description:
Selected so far: {picked}.

Some Wolf modules have sub-components (DHW, mixer circuit, solar) that do not appear as their own bus device. If any were found they are listed above -- the ones confirmed on the bus are pre-checked, the rest you can enable as needed.

{probe_note}

Missing an exotic sub-module? Pick "add more manually".

add_device.title: Step 4b -- Add manually

data.done: Done -- no more devices to add

data_description.device_type: Hint: sub-modules usually end in _BM, _BM-2 or _RM-2.
data_description.bus_address: Hex with 0x prefix, e.g. 0x35, 0x85, 0x7C. The address the module reports values on.
data_description.write_address: Leave empty -- for known modules (BM-2, CHA, WWSystem_BM-2 …) the correct write address is filled in automatically, otherwise it equals the read address. Only fill this in if your module needs a different address and wasn't recognised.

write_addresses.title: Step 4c -- Review write addresses
write_addresses.description:
Wolf modules report measured values on one bus address and -- for some modules -- receive control commands on another. The ISM7 detects the read address itself, but not the write address. For known modules (BM-2, CHA) the correct address is already pre-filled; for the rest it equals the read address.

Only change this if you know better. An empty field = same as the read address.

Modules:
{modules}

preset.title: Step 5 -- Choose data scope
preset.description:
Pick which scope of values should be collected. Counts vary a lot by module -- small sub-modules expose only a handful of values, a heat pump many more:

• Minimal -- just the read-only display values from the standard set (temperatures, status, counters -- no settings). About 1-30 values per module.

• Standard (recommended) -- a proven, hand-picked selection of the most important values per module, including setpoints and operating modes. For common Wolf modules this is a selection tested in everyday use; for rarer modules Wolf's own app selection applies. About 4-45 values per module.

• All values -- complete, everything the module exposes. About 9-160 values per module, longer initialization (~1-2 minutes for several modules).

• Manual -- you pick the values yourself (power-user).

select.title: Step 6 -- Select values
select.description: Pick which individual values to import. You can change the selection later via the integration options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate -- ISM7 {host}
reauth_confirm.description:
The ISM7 rejected the login (invalidcredentials).

Two possible causes:
• The password was changed -- enter the new one here.
• Another client occupies the ISM7's single connection slot (e.g. the ism7mqtt addon or Smartset) -- stop it first and re-enter the existing password.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed -- check host/IP and port, and that the ISM7 is reachable on the network.
error.invalid_auth: Login rejected -- wrong password, or another client (e.g. the ism7mqtt addon or Smartset) occupies the ISM7's single connection.
error.no_devices_added: Add at least one module before finishing
error.duplicate_device: This module is already configured (same device type and bus address).
error.missing_wolf_files: Wolf files missing: {files}. Please copy them to {path} (see README) and submit again.

abort.already_configured: This ISM7 gateway is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication saved -- the integration is reloading.

progress.discovering: Connecting to the ISM7 and querying the attached modules and sub-modules … This can take a moment.

init.title: EcoTherm Wolf -- Settings
init.description: Choose what you want to adjust:

parameters.title: Adjust values
parameters.description: Pick which values are imported. Changes apply immediately.

connection.title: Adjust connection
connection.description: Change host, port or password of the ISM7.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Update interval, stale threshold and diagnostic options.

reboot.title: ISM7 reboot watchdog
reboot.description: When the reconnect keeps failing after several attempts, reboot the ISM7 gateway automatically over HTTP (/protect/reboot.htm). Stays inactive until a reboot password is set. Threshold 0 = off.

data.reboot_after_failures: Reboot after X failed reconnect attempts (0 = off)
data.reboot_notify_service: Notify service on reboot (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone; empty = none)

browse_property.name: Read value
browse_property.description: Reads a single value without creating an entity.

list_properties.name: List available values
list_properties.description: Lists the available values and settings for one device or all devices.

reload_definitions.name: Reload device definitions
reload_definitions.description: Reloads device definitions and reports added, removed and changed values.

rediscover_devices.name: Rediscover devices
rediscover_devices.description: Searches the ISM7 for modules again and updates the existing device list.

diagnose.name: Show diagnostics
diagnose.description: Shows connection status and technical information for troubleshooting.

long_stale.title: ISM7 not delivering values
long_stale.description: No values from ISM7 for {minutes} minutes. Restart Wolf Link Home?

long_disconnect.title: ISM7 unreachable
long_disconnect.description: TCP connection to ISM7 has been down for several minutes. Check network and Wolf Link Home.

override_load_failed.title: Override definitions broken
override_load_failed.description: At least one XML file in /config/ecotherm_wolf_definitions/ failed to load. Check logs.

missing_wolf_files.title: Wolf files missing
missing_wolf_files.description:
EcoTherm Wolf needs the Wolf files device.xml, parameter.xml, converter.xml and client.pfx. Missing: {files}.

Please copy them to {path}. The integration then starts on its own, no restart needed.
